resource.name: Address: Adres (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of an address in Polish medical records, including TERYT identifiers. Specialises EHDSAddress from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: HealthProfessional: Pracownik medyczny (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a health professional in Polish medical records. Specialises EHDSHealthProfessional from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: HealthProfessionalRole: Rola zawodowa pracownika medycznego (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a professional role of a health professional in an organisation or a place of providing healthcare services. Corresponds to the professionalRole element of EHDSHealthProfessional from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: HumanName: Imię i nazwisko (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a person's name in Polish medical records. Specialises EHDSHumanName from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: Location: Lokalizacja (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a location in Polish medical records, i.e. a physical place where healthcare services may be provided. Specialises EHDSLocation from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: MedicalEntity: Podmiot medyczny (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a medical entity (healthcare provider) registered in the Register of Entities Performing Medical Activities (RPWDL).

resource.name: MedicalEntityCell: Komórka organizacyjna (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of an organisational cell of a medical entity (according to RPWDL), identified by parts I and VII of the departmental identification code.

resource.name: MedicalEntityFacility: Zakład podmiotu medycznego (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a facility (local unit) of a medical entity, identified by its own 14-digit REGON number.

resource.name: MedicalEntityUnit: Jednostka organizacyjna (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of an organisational unit of a medical entity (according to RPWDL), identified by parts I and V of the departmental identification code.

resource.name: MedicalPractice: Medyczna praktyka zawodowa (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a medical professional practice (of a physician, or of a nurse or midwife).

resource.name: Organisation: Organizacja (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of an organisation in Polish medical records, being the common base of medical entities, their organisational parts and medical practices. Specialises EHDSOrganisation from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: Patient: Pacjent (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of the patient identification data required in Polish medical records. Specialises EHDSPatient from the EHDS Common Logical Models.

resource.name: ServiceLocation: Miejsce udzielania świadczeń (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of a place of providing healthcare services, managed by an organisational cell of a medical entity or by a medical professional practice.

resource.name: Telecom: Dane kontaktowe (model domenowy)
resource.description: Domain model of contact details in Polish medical records. Specialises EHDSTelecom from the EHDS Common Logical Models, which holds the contact value (phone number, e-mail address).
